atomicOutcome: Standardize a shared color scale and actual observation record rather than retrospectively assign numbers to subjective impressions. Distinguish the scale from workplace acceptance criteria.

before.basis: Inspected all41 existing source34/35 checks; no color-reference or sensory-to-numeric check. Existing source34 observation/sampling practice asks about pooled equipment averages and sample bias.

sourcePropositionsUsed: Qualitative impressions can differ between people.
Shared color references can express qualitative color as a quantitative scale.
Correct collection and understanding of numbers are needed for process management.
exampleLimits: No invented product acceptance threshold, regulatory standard, calibration rule or universal factory procedure. Existing workplace criteria govern acceptance.
similarityReview: Original scenario and wording; manually compared against rendered Japanese source65–66. No source expression or artwork copied.
